programs.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programs.desc:
For two years, National Geographic explorer Bertie Gregory closely studied the tight-knit communities of some of the world's most intelligent penguins.He documented behaviors and situations that had previously been difficult to capture on camera.The series proves that penguins are much closer to humans than was previously known.These unique flightless birds are brave and adventurous, and at the same time value family bonds and friendship.Thanks to their ingenuity, they can survive in the most extreme conditions
20 years have passed since the premiere of the Oscar-winning "March of the Penguins".The three-part documentary series rediscovers the world of the inhabitants of the most hostile regions of the world.Today, groundbreaking technologies and scientific work allow us to look at flightless birds from a previously unavailable perspective.One of the guides to the penguin kingdom is Bertie Gregory, who camped with the team near the emperor penguin colony in Antarctica.The superhuman effort resulted in the recording of scenes that humans had never seen before.The most important thing is family. The first heroes of the bird saga are the largest representatives of the family - emperor penguins.For the first time, a television crew recorded an astonishing acrobatic display with their participation: hundreds of chicks of this species jumping from a 50-meter cliff into the icy ocean.Researchers also looked at the bonds between families, friends and strangers.In extreme conditions, social skills mean the difference between life and death.The cameras also included rockhopper, gentoo and golden-crested penguins.Filmmakers have discovered surprising behaviors of animals that can cooperate, take risks and even rebel.

programs.title: One Strange Rock
programs.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programs.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programs.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu reserve, a female leopard gives birth to two cubs and will do everything in her power to protect them.Progressing climate change causes resources to shrink, which leads to growing conflicts over territory.The film, which is the result of three years of careful observations, reveals previously unseen fascinating behaviors of these mysterious predators.Thanks to unique recordings, viewers can take a closer look at the fight for leopards' survival in a changing world.

programs.title: Animal fights
programs.desc: Unique shots of spectacular clashes involving the largest and most dangerous predators on our planet.This extraordinary series also features animals that, although seemingly gentle, are surprisingly belligerent when threatened.We will see how brave they are, among others.lions, wolves, hippos and crocodiles.We will see how much the result of the duel depends on strength and weapons such as teeth or claws, and how much on good tactics.The program used materials recorded by the best nature photographers, as well as films made by amateurs who witnessed fierce fights in the animal world.

programs.title: America's Wild Spaces
programs.desc: A story about the untamed forces of nature, danger and natural wonders that can be discovered in the wildest regions of America.Viewers, together with the creators of the series, will visit Everglades National Park, the Grand Canyon, Death Valley, Glacier National Park and Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park.Even though all these places seem to be well-known and explored, each of them hides its own secrets.A journey in the footsteps of wild America will go far beyond guidebooks.Areas will be explored where humans are still guests and must absolutely obey the rules of nature.
